channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport believes the Patriots and Ravens are “potential landing spots” for Daniel Jones.
item.description: Jones seemingly has decent odds of passing through waivers unclaimed, but he would be free to sign with any team after that. Rapoport adds that Jones is “still working his way back” from last year’s Achilles tendon rupture in his right, plant leg. Jones had a $10 million injury guarantee in his contract that is said to have been a factor in his release. Were he to sign with the Patriots, he could compete for the starting role with Tommy DeVito. Jacoby Brissett would probably be able to fend him off initially, were he to land in New England.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Team reporter Darren Urban believes Josh Johnson will “probably” start in Week 11 against the Cardinals.
item.description: Rookie Carson Beck is dealing with back spasms again, so recently signed journeyman Johnson will likely get the start this week. Urban notes that Johnson “played significant snaps for LaFleur in two games for the Jets in 2021, " completing 55-for-81 passes for 621 yards, five touchdowns and two interceptions. With six teams on bye, Johnson, 40, is in the low-end QB2 conversation.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) is not on the Broncos’ final injury report and will play in Week 11 against the Raiders.
item.description: Hufanga has not played since Week 5. He nearly returned in Week 9, pre-bye, but was unable to do so. His return could be helpful for a Broncos’ defense that struggles to cover tight ends. Broncos S Brandon Jones (hamstring) is questionable to play, and CB Riley Moss (concussion) is good to go.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Charlie Kolar (concussion) is questionable for Los Angeles’ Week 11 game against the Jets.
item.description: Kolar had not practiced either of the first two days of the week before this sudden Friday revival where he got in a limited session. We’d be surprised if he ultimately played coming off a short week, but no Chargers tight end is ultimately compelling with or without Kolar in the lineup.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Daiyan Henley (knee) will not play in Los Angeles’ Week 11 game against the Jets.
Ladd McConkey (back) is questionable for Los Angeles’ Week 11 game against the Jets.
item.description: McConkey was limited in all three sessions this week and was a shadow docket rule out in Week 9 while being a straight inactive in Week 10. Actually practicing ahead of this game is a sign things are better, but he’ll be no more than a WR3 in this dilapidated passing attack between the re-injury risk and the lack of upside. Yes, even against the Jets.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Isaiah Likely (groin) is not on the Giants’ final injury report and will play in Week 11 against the Jaguars.
item.description: Likely sat out on Friday after practicing in full, injury-free, on Wednesday and Thursday. With six teams on bye and very few reliable tight end options in fantasy, Likely remains in the TE1 tier. Monitoring his status throughout the weekend will be worthwhile. Hopefully, we continue to get positive reports on his groin injury. Likely notably dealt with a groin injury back in Week 5.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Matt Gay (hip) is questionable for Las Vegas’ Week 11 game against the Broncos.
item.description: Kansei Matsuzawa is on the Raiders’ practice squad and would presumably be elevated if the team rules out Gay. Neither player seems especially likely to be a good fantasy bet this week against the Broncos with a rookie quarterback under center.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Chris Rodriguez is not on Jacksonville’s final Week 11 injury report.
item.description: With Bhayshul Tuten not on the report either, Rodriguez looks likely to reprise his role as a clear backup against the Giants. He will not be worth gambling on in the FLEX spot without dramatic Tuten news ahead of Sunday.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Rachaad White (heel) was added to the injury report as a limited participant on Friday.
item.description: Mid-week additions to the injury report are generally a bad sign for a player’s availability. Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) is also practicing in full, potentially pushing White into the droppable tier once tomorrow’s official injury report is released. Stay tuned.-Nic Bodiford
